description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Attach Ice with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Ice Mode I: Rinoa], [Ice Resonance +5% Boost] and [Instant Cast 2] to the user

description.name: Attach Ice with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Dual Awoken Ice Mode I: Rinoa
description.text: Ice abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ice abilities trigger 2 additional times, casts Dual Ice Apocalypse after using Ice abilities (max 2)

description.name: Dual Shift
